preserve.notes: Page header on every page: "Version 1 – 31.01.2018" and ethics reference "MREC06/Q0104/133". No PAGE/NUMPAGES fields; header has no answer areas.
Form title "Detailed Patient Headache Questionnaire (Current Headache)".

Intro paragraph; Q18 trigger definition; Q8 inline instruction "If yes, focus on your worst headache type while answering the following questions." Also the per-question "Please tick all that apply"/"please circle the number" phrases.
Q7 scale anchor labels "Not at all painful" / "Most severe pain possible" under 0 and 10.
All 22 checkbox content controls are unchecked (checked=0; MS Gothic ☐ 2610 / ☒ 2612). All 190 U+20DD option glyphs are unmarked. Only answered options may change.
Closing line "Thank you for taking the time to complete this questionnaire" (bold, with rule lines).

difficulties: All 190 option markers are bare U+20DD COMBINING ENCLOSING CIRCLE characters in ordinary text runs (no checkbox semantics, not reported as glyph slots); when a circle sits alone in its run LibreOffice draws it on a dotted-circle base ("○◯"), so marking an option means replacing/overlaying that glyph without disturbing its label. Many questions put a No/Yes glyph pair and an "if yes" underscore run in the SAME paragraph, and several paragraphs hold 3-6 options plus an Other underscore run, so one slot carries multiple answer areas. Two-level answers: 22 checkbox content controls (Right/Left, Larger/Smaller, Red/White) are nested inside glyph options (Q9, Q16, Q17, Q18). Sub-options printed at 9pt (Alcohol beverages > Wine/Other; Menstruation > Before/During/After) are subordinate to a parent option. Q7 is two circle-the-number 0-10 scales in nested 11-column tables. The whole body is one shaded 1-column table spanning 4 pages with nested option grids (gridSpan merges, empty spacer cells); Q24 and Q25 share a row. Long underscore runs wrap across two printed lines; "Other" and "if yes, please expand" labels repeat many times. It is a patient-reported questionnaire, so answers are the patient's history rather than examination findings.
unsupportable: None strictly unsupportable. Q7 "circle the number" requires a drawn mark around a printed number; a filler can only emulate it (e.g. highlight/encircle the chosen cell), which is recorded in scope.

review_changes.area: A61 (Q18 Hormonal > Menstruation: Before / During / After)
review_changes.why: Kind changed from choice to multi_choice: the three timing sub-options are not mutually exclusive (perimenstrual headache can be both before and during menses) and Q18 as a whole is an 'indicate any triggers' list; a single-choice ground truth would wrongly penalise a filler that marks two timings.
